captures.description: THE SITE, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'Labor Vector is a conceptual framework by Lee Sharks on the Labor Vector Website that maps the path semantic labor travels through a system: C → T → R → O → A (Capacity, Task-origin, Retrieval, Output, Attribution).' The five stages; a note on the VectorStock homonym. Two cards: laborvector.org ('Directionality of Semantic Labor — Lee Sharks | Labor Vector'), VectorStock.
